assert.//: Baselines start as warnings so the first CI run records the numbers without breaking the build. Tighten to 'error' once the public-route scores are known-good. Tool routes are public (browser-only, no sign-in), so a representative tool (/capacity-planner) and the comic reader (/agile-at-work — it shows 'coming soon' until public/comics/agile-at-work.pdf is committed) are baselined alongside the landing page. Owner-only pages (/settings/*) still need an authenticated run (puppeteerScript), which is out of scope.
